summary: Failed Email Resend feature tested end-to-end. Backend 12/12 pytest pass (retryable_count on both GETs, 404/409/409/409/422 single retry, 422 returns JSON not proxy HTML, retried_at+retry_event_id stamped, no double replay, >7d rows skipped by retry-all, attempted<=60, 403 for non-master on all 4 endpoints, _repair_from swaps @pulsefitness.com -> @modservice.pulsefitness.com and retry rows carry the repaired sender). Frontend: Email pill dialog shows red per-row Resend + 'Resend all failed (N)' next to 'Last 5 attempts'; single Resend -> 'Retry failed / Resend rejected it again: ResendError(API key is invalid)' toast; Resend all -> '0 resent, 60 still failing' toast in ~15s, no crash. Outbound emails page (/master-admin?section=emails) header 'Resend all failed (99)' + expanded failed row Resend both work with same toasts. Found + fixed a light-theme contrast bug: Resend buttons rendered dark text (rgb 24,24,27) on rose-600 because the global [data-theme=light] .text-white override did not whitelist bg-rose-600.

minor.issue: Every failed retry inserts a NEW retryable failed row, so retryable_count never drops while Resend keeps failing (stayed 99 after 2 resend-all runs) and 'Failed (24h)' inflates by up to 60 per tap (245 -> 306 -> 367). Consider excluding retry_of rows from the failed_24h stat, or showing originals-only counts.

Per-row retryable flag doesn't apply the 7-day RETRY_WINDOW_DAYS or payload.html check used by _retryable_query, so a row older than 7d (or payload without html) shows a Resend button but isn't counted in 'Resend all (N)'; a payload lacking html shows Resend but returns 409.

ui_bugs.issue: FIXED by testing agent: light theme turned text-white into dark text on bg-rose-600 Resend buttons (low contrast). Added .bg-rose-600(.text-white) to the white-preserve list in index.css. Verified computed color now rgb(255,255,255).

issues: 'Last 5 attempts' becomes dominated by retry rows after a Resend all, pushing original context out; acceptable but noisy.

action_items: Optional: stop retry rows inflating Failed(24h)/retryable_count (or label count as 'pending resend' that only counts latest attempt per original — already the case, but it never decreases while failing).
Optional: align per-row `retryable` with _retryable_query (7-day window + payload.html).
critical_code_review_comments: retry-failed processes up to 60 sends serially in one request (~15s in preview with fast-failing key); with a valid key + rate limiter this could approach the ingress timeout — consider background job or smaller batch.
AdminEmails list returns retried_at/retry_event_id unpopped (harmless; datetime serialized).
seed_data_creation: Temporary TEST_iter283* email_send_events rows seeded and deleted afterwards. Note: the Resend-all runs replayed real preview failed rows (~120 originals now have retried_at and spawned new failed retry rows) — harmless in preview since key is invalid.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Login admin@pulsefitness.com (MFA off in preview). Outbound emails at /master-admin?section=emails. Seed failed rows with payload.html directly in db.email_send_events to get Resend buttons. Resend key invalid -> all retries fail with 422 / 'X still failing' toast (expected).
